text:
Opens a File Storage.
OpenFileStorage will fail with kResourceBusy when the File Storage is currently being modified
by a call from another thread to UpdatePersistency, CleanUpPersistency, ResetPersistency,
RecoverAllFiles, or ResetAllFiles.
Because multiple threads can access the same File Storage concurrently, the File Storage might
not be closed when the SharedHandle returned by this function goes out of scope. It will only be
closed when all SharedHandles that refer to the same File Storage went out of scope.
